description:
Field phenotypes of wheat cultivars and genebank accessions from IPK e!DAL (CC BY 4.0). Datasets: 'GABI-WHEAT'
(372 European elite cultivars 1975-2007; 16 traits incl. grain yield, heading, height, TKW, protein, sedimentation,
falling number, FHB, Septoria, tan spot; BLUEs per trial environment and across 2009-2010 trials in Germany/France),
'IPK' (12,754 IPK genebank accessions, TRI numbers: flowering time, plant height, TKW, BLUEs across 70 years of
regeneration), 'EU-GENEBANKS' (about 40,000 accessions of CREA, ICARDA, IHAR, INIA, IPGR, NARDI, NPPC, Agroscope:
heading, height, TKW, some disease, protein and yield). No arguments lists datasets and traits.
query: a cultivar name or accession number (e.g. 'Julius', 'TRI 1000', 'IG 107099') -> all its trait values.
trait (+ order 'high'/'low'): rank accessions of one dataset. filters: several traits at once, e.g.
'plant height < 90; thousand kernel weight > 45' (BLUEs, one dataset). genebank: FAO code or name (LBN002, CREA);
country: origin (IPK dataset).
name: genebank_phenotypes
